description: This file defines the configuration class for the Claim plugin within the OrangeHRM system. It implements the PluginConfigurationInterface and registers the ClaimService with the service container during initialization.

classes.name: ClaimPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for the Claim plugin, responsible for setting up the claim service in the dependency injection container.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin configuration by registering the ClaimService into the container during plugin setup.
